IKEA BILRESA Umbau zu einem Vier-Tasten-Wandschalter

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2712956-ikea-bilresa-to-four-button-wall-switch-conversion#profileId-3011559

### Description

3D model to convert IKEA BILRESA smart button into wall switch, reusing its PCB. To make four button switch, you need 2 IKEA BILRESA switches.

Opening BILRESA switch is easy, case doesn't need to be damaged and it can be assembled back.

 

### Available in 2 variants

With and without center line.

 

### Installation video

 

This model allows you to convert your IKEA BILRESA smart switch into four button wall switch with bigger push areas.

 

Additionally it allows you to define your own icons. Just download icon in SVG for example from material design, and in slicer double-click on icon → Edit SVG and select to replace icon.

 

### Multiple variants

Available also in single button or dual button version - check the collection 

 

### Custom mounting brackets

I received several requests for custom mounting brackets for various situations. In files is available IKEA BILRESA wall enclosure.step. Everyone is allowed to design custom bracket compatible with this switch and share it as print profile.

Membership

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: With center line - 0.4mm nozzle PLA
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 3
- Infill: 25%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#000000)
